technique_name: Generate a short demonstration for how to make banana bread.
description: To make banana bread, preheat the oven to 350°F. In a medium bowl, mash 2 ripe bananas with a fork. In another bowl, whisk together 1 1/2 cups flour, 1 teaspoon baking powder, 1 teaspoon baking soda, and 1/2 teaspoon salt. In a larger bowl, cream together 1/2 cup of butter and 1/2 cup of sugar until light and fluffy. Add 2 eggs, one at a time, then mix in the mashed bananas.
